t: The Brackenheath iSpot Swivel is an outdoor LED floodlight designed for reliable security lighting. This durable fixture is ideal for illuminating domestic driveways, commercial yards and building perimeters. It delivers a bright 1050lm cool white light from 8.5W. The IP65-rated polycarbonate body features a 180° PIR motion sensor with a 10m range, alongside an adjustable photocell. With a 180° swivel and 70° tilt head, installers can easily direct coverage. It offers 3-in-1 control including manual override. The PIR can control up to 8 fittings (max. 150W LED load) when linked in series.
